title: PoQ-Judge：面向去中心化LLM推理的轻量级质量评估框架
summary: PoQ-Judge是一个用于去中心化LLM推理网络的轻量级、无参考质量评估框架。它训练专用评判模型对查询-输出对进行评分，无需真实参考答案。研究了TextCNN、MiniLM和DeBERTa三种架构，最佳模型与真实代理的皮尔逊相关系数达0.747，且作为无参考组件时匹配最佳单参考评估器。级联评估可降低72.7%成本，仅轻微质量损失。
summary_en: PoQ-Judge is a lightweight, reference-free quality evaluation framework for decentralized LLM inference networks. It trains dedicated judge models to score query-output pairs without ground-truth references. The best model achieves 0.747 Pearson correlation with ground-truth proxy, and as a reference-free component matches the best single reference-based evaluator. Cascade evaluation reduces cost by 72.7% with modest quality loss.
